<?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option('permalink_structure','/%postname%/');
update_option('woocommerce_currency','ILS');
update_option('woocommerce_default_country','IL');
update_option('woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array('skipped' => true));
$cats = json_decode(base64_decode(''), true);
$n = 0;
foreach ($cats as $c) {
  $top = term_exists($c['title'], 'product_cat') ?: wp_insert_term($c['title'], 'product_cat', array('slug' => $c['slug'], 'description' => $c['lead']));
  $top_id = is_array($top) ? (int) $top['term_id'] : (int) $top;
  foreach ($c['groups'] as $gi => $g) {
    $gid = $top_id;
    if (count($c['groups']) > 1) {
      $sub = term_exists($g['name'], 'product_cat', $top_id) ?: wp_insert_term($g['name'], 'product_cat', array('parent' => $top_id, 'slug' => $c['slug'] . '-' . ($gi + 1)));
      $gid = is_array($sub) ? (int) $sub['term_id'] : (int) $sub;
    }
    foreach ($g['items'] as $it) {
      if ($c['kind'] === 'wall') {
        // a picture: a simple product with a format (portrait to start); sizes + prices come from the theme's price list
        // (מוצרים → מחירון תמונות, inc/addons.php). Its own price is kept at the lowest option for listings.
        $p = new WC_Product_Simple();
        $p->set_name($it[0]);
        $p->set_status('publish');
        $p->set_catalog_visibility('visible');
        $p->set_category_ids(array_values(array_unique(array($top_id, $gid))));
        if ($it[1] !== '') $p->set_short_description($it[1]);
        $p->set_regular_price('69');
        $pid = $p->save();
        update_post_meta($pid, '_lev_format', 'portrait');
        $n++;
        continue;
      }
      // a variable product: every option list from the design is a dropdown; the first one (size / contents) sets the price
      $p = new WC_Product_Variable();
      $p->set_name($it[0]);
      $p->set_status('publish');
      $p->set_catalog_visibility('visible');
      $p->set_category_ids(array_values(array_unique(array($top_id, $gid))));
      if ($it[1] !== '') $p->set_short_description($it[1]);
      $attrs = array();
      foreach ($c['attrs'] as $ai => $a) {
        $at = new WC_Product_Attribute();
        $at->set_name($a[0]); $at->set_options($a[1]); $at->set_position($ai); $at->set_visible(true); $at->set_variation(true);
        $attrs[] = $at;
      }
      $p->set_attributes($attrs);
      $def = array(); foreach ($c['attrs'] as $a) { $def[sanitize_title($a[0])] = $a[1][0]; }
      $p->set_default_attributes($def); // opens with the first option of each list already chosen
      $pid = $p->save();
      if ($c['attrs']) {
        $first = $c['attrs'][0];
        foreach ($first[1] as $vi => $val) {
          $v = new WC_Product_Variation();
          $v->set_parent_id($pid);
          $v->set_attributes(array(sanitize_title($first[0]) => $val)); // the other options stay "any"
          $v->set_regular_price((string) $c['prices'][min($vi, count($c['prices']) - 1)]);
          $v->set_status('publish');
          $v->save();
        }
        WC_Product_Variable::sync($pid);
      }
      $n++;
    }
  }
}
update_option('shoval_products_created', $n);
update_option('blogname','לב היהדות');
update_option('blogdescription','אמנות שמחברת את הנשמה');
update_option('woocommerce_enable_myaccount_registration','yes');
update_option('woocommerce_coming_soon','no');
// the shop's own pages, in Hebrew
foreach (array('shop' => 'כל המוצרים', 'cart' => 'סל הקניות', 'checkout' => 'תשלום', 'myaccount' => 'החשבון שלי') as $k => $t) {
  $id = wc_get_page_id($k); if ($id > 0) wp_update_post(array('ID' => $id, 'post_title' => $t));
}
// contact + legal pages (templates with [blanks] for Shoval's details)
$pg = array();
foreach (json_decode(base64_decode(''), true) as $p) {
  $pg[$p['slug']] = wp_insert_post(array('post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_name' => $p['slug'], 'post_title' => $p['title'], 'post_content' => $p['content']));
}
update_option('woocommerce_terms_page_id', $pg['terms']);
update_option('wp_page_for_privacy_policy', $pg['privacy']);
// order emails in the shop's colours, from the shop's name
update_option('woocommerce_email_from_name', 'לב היהדות');
update_option('woocommerce_email_base_color', '#9b7b35');
update_option('woocommerce_email_background_color', '#f7f2e9');
update_option('woocommerce_email_body_background_color', '#fffdf9');
update_option('woocommerce_email_text_color', '#1c1915');
// test checkout: "pay on delivery" until Shoval chooses a payment company
$cod = get_option('woocommerce_cod_settings', array());
update_option('woocommerce_cod_settings', array_merge((array) $cod, array('enabled' => 'yes', 'title' => 'תשלום בזמן האיסוף (לבדיקה)')));
// flat shipping for all of Israel so checkout shows a shipping line (Shoval sets the real price)
if (class_exists('WC_Shipping_Zone')) {
  $z = new WC_Shipping_Zone(); $z->set_zone_name('ישראל'); $z->add_location('IL', 'country'); $z->save();
  $iid = $z->add_shipping_method('flat_rate');
  update_option('woocommerce_flat_rate_' . $iid . '_settings', array('title' => 'משלוח עד הבית', 'cost' => '35', 'tax_status' => 'none'));
}
// the six best-sellers on the home page: marked featured (the star in the product list)
foreach (array('ברכת הבית','הכותל המערבי','פמוטים לשבת – כסף','חנוכייה – קריסטל','מזוזה מהודרת','מתנה לבית חדש') as $t) {
  $q = get_posts(array('post_type'=>'product','title'=>$t,'numberposts'=>1));
  if ($q) { $p = wc_get_product($q[0]->ID); $p->set_featured(true); $p->save(); }
}
